Contact support@example.com to request a refund.\\\" }], context_type=\\\"resource\\\", source=\\\"documentation\\\", scope=\\\"internal\\\" ) print(f\\\"✅ Stored {len(result.get('documents', []))} documents\\\") # Output: ✅ Stored 1 documents ``` \\n\\n**What just happened:**\\n\\n* Your document was chunked into searchable pieces (\\\\~500 word chunks)\\n* Embeddings were generated REDACTEDmatically (vector representations)\\n* Everything is indexed and ready to search\\n\\n**Verify it worked:**\\n\\n1. Visit [platform.getalchemystai.com/context](https://platform.getalchemystai.com/context?utm_source=docs\\\\&utm_campaign=contextual_ai_quickstart\\\\&utm_medium=quickstart_article\\\\&utm_content=verify_setup_context_link)\\n2. You should see your document listed\\n3. Click to view chunks and metadata\\n\\n***\\n\\n## Step 4: Search for Context\\n\\n ```typescript TypeScript theme={null} const userQuestion = \\\"What's your refund policy?\\\"; const { contexts } = await client.v1.context.search({ query: userQuestion, similarity_threshold: 0.7, scope: 'internal' }); console.log(`Found ${contexts?.length || 0} relevant chunks`); // Output: Found 1 relevant chunks console.log(contexts[0].content); // Output: \\\"Our refund policy: We offer a 30-day money back guarantee...\\\" ``` ```python Python theme={null} user_question = \\\"What's your refund policy?\\\" result = client.v1.context.search( query=user_question, similarity_threshold=0.7, scope=\\\"internal\\\" ) contexts = result.contexts or [] print(f\\\"Found {len(contexts)} relevant chunks\\\") # Output: Found 1 relevant chunks print(contexts[0].content) # Output: \\\"Our refund policy: We offer a 30-day money back guarantee...\\\" ``` \\n\\n### Understanding similarity\\\\_threshold\\n\\n| Value | Meaning           | When to Use                        |\\n| ----- | ----------------- | ---------------------------------- |\\n| `0.5` | Somewhat relevant | Exploratory searches, broad topics |\\n| `0.7` | Relevant          | **Start here** - good balance      |\\n| `0.9` | Very relevant     | Precise matches, technical queries |\\n\\n **Tip:** Start at 0.7, lower to 0.5 if you get no results, raise to 0.9 if results are too broad. \\n\\n***\\n\\n## Step 5: Feed Context to Your LLM\\n\\n ```typescript TypeScript theme={null} import OpenAI from 'openai'; const openai = new OpenAI(); const prompt = contexts?.length ? `Context:\\\\n${contexts.map(c => c.content).join('\\\\n\\\\n')}\\\\n\\\\nQuestion: ${userQuestion}` : userQuestion; const response = await openai.chat.completions.create({ model: \\\"gpt-4\\\", messages: [{ role: \\\"user\\\", content: prompt }] }); console.log(response.choices[0].message.content); // Output: \\\"We offer a 30-day money back guarantee. To request a refund, contact support@example.com.\\\" ``` ```python Python theme={null} import openai if contexts: context_text = \\\"\\\\n\\\\n\\\".join([ctx.content for ctx in contexts]) prompt = f\\\"Context:\\\\n{context_text}\\\\n\\\\nQuestion: {user_question}\\\" else: prompt = user_question response = openai.chat.completions.create( model=\\\"gpt-4\\\", messages=[{\\\"role\\\": \\\"user\\\", \\\"content\\\": prompt}] ) print(response.choices[0].message.content) # Output: \\\"We offer a 30-day money back guarantee. To request a refund, contact support@example.com.\\\" ``` \\n\\n**Result:** Your AI now answers from YOUR data, not generic training data.\\n\\n***\\n\\n## Complete Working Example\\n\\n  ```typescript theme={null} import AlchemystAI from '@alchemystai/sdk'; import OpenAI from 'openai'; const alchemyst = new AlchemystAI({ apiKey: process.env.ALCHEMYST_AI_API_KEY, }); const openai = new OpenAI(); async function main() { // 1. // Search within specific groups const { contexts } = await client.v1.context.search({ query: \\\"refund policy\\\", scope: 'internal', metadata: { groupName: ['customer-support'] // ← For search (note: camelCase) } }); console.log(`Found ${contexts?.length} results in customer-support`); ``` ```python Python theme={null} # Store with groups client.v1.context.add( documents=[{ \\\"content\\\": \\\"Refund policy: We offer a 30-day money back guarantee...\\\", \\\"metadata\\\": { \\\"file_name\\\": \\\"refund-policy.md\\\", \\\"group_name\\\": [\\\"customer-support\\\", \\\"policies\\\"] # ← For storage } }], context_type=\\\"resource\\\", source=\\\"documentation\\\", scope=\\\"internal\\\" ) # Search within specific groups result = client.v1.context.search( query=\\\"refund policy\\\", scope=\\\"internal\\\", metadata={ \\\"group_name\\\": [\\\"customer-support\\\"] # ← For search (note: snake_case) } ) print(f\\\"Found {len(result.contexts or [])} results in customer-support\\\") ``` \\n\\n **Naming difference:** Storage uses `group_name` (snake\\\\_case in metadata) but TypeScript search uses `groupName` (camelCase). Python uses `group_name` consistently. Both refer to the same field - this is due to API design conventions. \\n\\n### Why use groups?\\n\\n| Benefit                 | Description                                             |\\n| ----------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------- |\\n| **Faster searches**     | Smaller search space = lower latency                    |\\n| **More relevant**       | Only search customer-support docs, not engineering docs |\\n| **Better organization** | Hierarchical structure like folders                     |\\n| **Access control**      | Filter by team, project, or user permissions            |\\n\\n**Example hierarchy:**\\n\\n```typescript theme={null}\\ngroup_name: [\\\"company\\\", \\\"customer-support\\\", \\\"policies\\\"]\\ngroup_name: [\\\"company\\\", \\\"engineering\\\", \\\"api-docs\\\"]\\ngroup_name: [\\\"company\\\", \\\"hr\\\", \\\"employee-handbook\\\"]\\n```\\n\\nLearn more: [Context Arithmetic](/advanced/context-arithmetic)\\n\\n***\\n\\n## Troubleshooting\\n\\n  **Error symptoms:** * `contexts?.length` returns 0 * Empty array in search results **Common causes:** 1. `similarity_threshold` is too high 2. Document wasn't stored successfully 3. `scope` mismatch between add and search **Fixes:** **Step 1: Lower the threshold:** ```typescript theme={null} similarity_threshold: 0.5 // Instead of 0.9 ``` **Step 2: Verify documents were stored:** ```typescript theme={null} const stored = await client.v1.context.view(); console.log(\\\"Total documents:\\\", stored.length); console.log(\\\"Documents:\\\", stored); ``` **Expected output:** ``` Total documents: 1 Documents: [{ id: \\\"doc_123\\\", content: \\\"Our refund policy...\\\", ... }] ``` **Step 3: Check scope matches:** ```typescript theme={null} // Both must use the same scope await client.v1.context.add({ scope: 'internal', ... }); await client.v1.context.search({ scope: 'internal', ... }); // ✅ Match ```   **Error symptoms:** * Getting documents that don't match the query * Too many results to process efficiently **Common causes:** 1. `similarity_threshold` is too low 2. Documents are too broad or generic 3. Not using group filtering **Fixes:** **Step 1: Raise the threshold:** ```typescript theme={null} similarity_threshold: 0.8 // More strict (was 0.5) ``` **Step 2: Use group filtering:** ```typescript theme={null} metadata: { groupName: ['customer-support'] // Narrow to specific category } ``` **Step 3: Add more specific metadata:** ```typescript theme={null} await client.v1.context.add({ documents: [{ content: \\\"...\\\", metadata: { group_name: [\\\"support\\\", \\\"refunds\\\"], // More specific category: \\\"policies\\\", department: \\\"customer-service\\\" } }] }); ```   **Error message:** ```json theme={null} { \\\"error\\\": \\\"Document with file_name 'policy.md' already exists\\\", \\\"code\\\": \\\"CONFLICT\\\", \\\"status\\\": 409 } ``` **Cause:** Trying to add a document with duplicate `file_name` in metadata. **Fixes:** **Step 1: Delete old version first:** ```typescript theme={null} // Delete by file name await client.v1.context.delete({ metadata: { fileName: \\\"policy.md\\\" } }); // Then add new version await client.v1.context.add({ documents: [{ content: \\\"Updated content...\\\", metadata: { file_name: \\\"policy.md\\\" } }] }); ``` **Step 2: Use versioned names:** ```typescript theme={null} file_name: \\\"policy-v2.md\\\" // or \\\"policy-2024-02-01.md\\\" ``` **Step 3: Use unique identifiers:** ```typescript theme={null} file_name: `policy-${Date.now()}.md` // Timestamp // or file_name: `policy-${uuid()}.md` // UUID ```   **Error message:** ```json theme={null} { \\\"error\\\": \\\"Invalid API key\\\", \\\"code\\\": \\\"UNAUTHORIZED\\\", \\\"status\\\": 401 } ``` **Fixes:** **Step 1: Verify API key is set:** ```typescript theme={null} console.log(\\\"API Key exists:\\\", !!process.env.ALCHEMYST_AI_API_KEY); // Should output: API Key exists: true ``` **Step 2: Check key format:** ```typescript theme={null} // Should start with \\\"alch_\\\" or similar prefix console.log(\\\"Key prefix:\\\", process.env.ALCHEMYST_AI_API_KEY?.substring(0, 5)); ``` **Step 3: Get a new key:** * Visit [platform.getalchemystai.com/settings](https://platform.getalchemystai.com/settings?utm_source=docs\\\\&utm_campaign=contextual_ai_quickstart\\\\&utm_medium=quickstart_article\\\\&utm_content=troubleshooting_api_key_settings) * Generate a new API key * Update your `.env` file   **Error message:** ```json theme={null} { \\\"error\\\": \\\"Rate limit exceeded\\\", \\\"code\\\": \\\"RATE_LIMIT\\\", \\\"status\\\": 429, \\\"retry_after\\\": 60 } ``` **Cause:** Too many requests in a short time period. **Fixes:** **Step 1: Add retry logic:** ```typescript theme={null} async function searchWithRetry(query: string, retries = 3) { for (let i = 0; i < retries; i++) { try { return await client.v1.context.search({ query, scope: 'internal' }); } catch (error) { if (error.status === 429 && i < retries - 1) { const waitTime = error.retry_after || 60; console.log(`Rate limited. Waiting ${waitTime}s...`); await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, waitTime * 1000)); } else { throw error; } } } } ``` **Step 2: Check your rate limits:** * Free tier: 100 operations/day * Pro tier: 10,000 operations/day **Step 3: Upgrade your plan:** [View pricing](https://platform.getalchemystai.com/settings/billing?utm_source=docs\\\\&utm_campaign=contextual_ai_quickstart\\\\&utm_medium=quickstart_article\\\\&utm_content=troubleshooting_rate_limit_billing) \\n\\n***\\n\\n## Best Practices\\n\\n### Document Organization\\n\\n```typescript theme={null}\\n// ✅ Good - organized with meaningful metadata\\nawait client.v1.context.add({\\n  documents: [{\\n    content: \\\"...\\\",\\n    metadata: {\\n      file_name: \\\"refund-policy-2024-02.md\\\",\\n      group_name: [\\\"customer-support\\\", \\\"policies\\\"],\\n      department: \\\"support\\\",\\n      last_updated: \\\"2024-02-01\\\"\\n    }\\n  }]\\n});\\n\\n// ❌ Bad - minimal metadata, hard to search\\nawait client.v1.context.add({\\n  documents: [{\\n    content: \\\"...\\\"\\n  }]\\n});\\n```\\n\\n### Chunk Size Considerations\\n\\n* **Small documents** (under 1000 words): Add as-is\\n* **Medium documents** (1000-5000 words): Let Alchemyst REDACTED-chunk\\n* **Large documents** (over 5000 words): Consider splitting by section\\n\\n```typescript theme={null}\\n// For large documents, split manually for better control\\nconst sections = [\\n  { title: \\\"Introduction\\\", content: \\\"...\\\" },\\n  { title: \\\"Features\\\", content: \\\"...\\\" },\\n  { title: \\\"Pricing\\\", content: \\\"...\\\" }\\n];\\n\\nconst docs = sections.map(section => ({\\n  content: section.content,\\n  metadata: {\\n    file_name: \\\"product-docs.md\\\",\\n    section: section.title\\n  }\\n}));\\n\\nawait client.v1.context.add({ documents: docs });\\n```\\n\\n### Search Optimization\\n\\n```typescript theme={null}\\n// ✅ Good - specific query with filtering\\nconst { contexts } = await client.v1.context.search({\\n  query: \\\"How to request a refund for damaged items\\\",\\n  scope: 'internal',\\n  similarity_threshold: 0.7,\\n  metadata: {\\n    groupName: ['customer-support', 'refunds']\\n  }\\n});\\n\\n// ❌ Bad - too broad, no filtering\\nconst { contexts } = await client.v1.context.search({\\n  query: \\\"help\\\",\\n  scope: 'internal'\\n});\\n```\\n\\n### Error Handling\\n\\n```typescript theme={null}\\nasync function safeSearch(query: string) {\\n  try {\\n    const { contexts } = await client.v1.context.search({\\n      query,\\n      scope: 'internal',\\n      similarity_threshold: 0.7\\n    });\\n    \\n    if (!contexts || contexts.length === 0) {\\n      console.log(\\\"No results found. Try a broader query.\\\");\\n      return null;\\n    }\\n    \\n    return contexts;\\n  } catch (error) {\\n    console.error(\\\"Search failed:\\\", error.message);\\n    // Fallback or retry logic here\\n    return null;\\n  }\\n}\\n```\\n\\n***\\n\\n## Verify Your Setup\\n\\nAfter implementing context search, verify everything is working:\\n\\n### Check Platform UI\\n\\n1. [see Upload Errors](#common-errors-add)\\n* Search not working? [go to Search Errors](#common-errors-search)\\n* Slow performance? [look at Performance Issues](#performance-issues)\\n* Wrong results? [Check Retrieval Quality](#retrieval-quality-issues)\\n\\n## API Errors\\n\\n### Common errors (Add)\\n\\n| Status Code | Error Type        | Common Cause                                                                      | Recommended Fix                                                                                                                                       |\\n| :---------- | :---------------- | :-------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | :---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |\\n| **400**     | `BadRequest`      | Invalid JSON or missing required fields (e.g., `source`).                         | Validate your payload against the [schema](/api-reference/endpoint/api/v1/context/add/post). Ensure `documents` array is not empty.                   |\\n| **401**     | `Unauthorized`    | Invalid or missing `ALCHEMYST_AI_API_KEY`.                                        | Check your `.env` file. Ensure you aren't using a Test key in Prod.                                                                                   |\\n| **403**     | `Forbidden`       | Accessing a `scope` (e.g., `user_123`) you don't have permission for.             | Verify the `api_key` or `user_id` matches the authenticated session. Make sure the key is still valid.                                                |\\n| **409**     | `Conflict`        | Document with the same `fileName` already exists.                                 | Follow [Pattern 2: Document Updates](/advanced/usage-patterns#pattern-2%3A-handling-document-updates) to update or replace existing documents safely. |\\n| **413**     | `PayloadTooLarge` | Document exceeds the 50MB limit or batch size > 100.                              | Split your `documents` array into chunks of 50 and retry.                                                                                             |\\n| **429**     | `RateLimit`       | Exceeded 1000 requests/minute.                                                    | Implement exponential backoff (default in SDK). Contact support for higher limits.                                                                    |\\n| **422**     | `Unprocessable`   | The file type provided in `metadata` matches `source` but content is unparseable. | Ensure `fileType` matches the actual binary content (e.g., don’t send PDF bytes as `text/plain`).                                                     |\\n\\n### Common errors (Search)\\n\\n| Status Code | Error Type      | Common Cause                                  | Recommended Fix                                                                                                                             |\\n| :---------- | :-------------- | :-------------------------------------------- | :------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |\\n| **400**     | `BadRequest`    | Missing or malformed search parameters.       | Ensure `query` is provided and properly formatted.Validate your payload against the [schema](/api-reference/endpoint/api/v1/context/search) |\\n| **401**     | `Unauthorized`  | Invalid or missing `ALCHEMYST_AI_API_KEY`.    | Confirm the request includes a valid API key.                                                                                               |\\n| **403**     | `Forbidden`     | Searching a `scope` you don't have access to. | Make sure the key is still valid. Ensure the search `scope` is accessible to the current user or org.                                       |\\n| **429**     | `RateLimit`     | Too many search requests.                     | Add throttling or cache repeated searches.                                                                                                  |\\n| **422**     | `Unprocessable` | Documents were not indexed correctly.         | Verify documents were successfully ingested before searching.                                                                               |\\n\\n## Application-Level Issues\\n\\n### Performance issues\\n\\n#### Slow Ingestion\\n\\n**Diagnosis:**\\n\\n```javascript theme={null}\\n// Sequential adds: ~30 seconds for 1000 docs\\nfor (let i = 0; i < 1000; i++) {\\n  await alchemyst.add(documents[i]);\\n}\\n\\n// Async add: ~3 seconds for 1000 docs (10x faster!)\\n// documents is an array of content\\nconst documents = [];\\ndocuments.push({\\n  content: \\\"files content\\\",\\n  metadata: { // optional\\n    file_name: \\\"file_name\\\",\\n    file_type: \\\"pdf/txt/json\\\",\\n    group_name: [\\\"group1\\\", \\\"group2\\\"],\\n  },\\n});\\n\\nawait alchemyst.add(documents);\\n```\\n\\n**Common Causes:**\\n\\n* Document size > 50MB (max file size - 50MB)\\n* Large number of documents uploaded sequentially\\n* Token limit reached\\n\\n**Solutions :**\\n\\n1. Make sure the doc size is less then 50MB\\n2. Upload documents via bulkAdd (faster)\\n3. Check if you have sufficent tokens\\n4. For bulk operations read [here](/advanced/usage-patterns#pattern-4%3A-bulk-operations-at-scale)\\n\\n***\\n\\n#### Slow Searches (> 1 second)\\n\\n**Quick Checks:**\\n\\n```javascript theme={null}\\n// Measure your query time\\nconst start = Date.now();\\nconst result = await alchemyst.v1.context.search({\\n  groupName: [\\\"a\\\", \\\"b\\\", \\\"c\\\", \\\"d\\\", \\\"e\\\", \\\"f\\\", \\\"g\\\"] // 7 filters!\\n});\\nconsole.log(`Search took ${Date.now() - start}ms`);\\n```\\n\\n**Common Causes:**\\n\\n* 7+ groupName tags (exponential overhead)\\n* No minimum\\\\_similarity\\\\_threshold set\\n* 10K+ documents in scope\\n\\n**Solutions:**\\n\\n1. Reduce to 3-5 groupName tags max\\n2. Set minimum\\\\_similarity\\\\_threshold: 0.5\\n3. Use namespaces to shard data\\n\\n***\\n\\n### Retrieval Quality Issues\\n\\n#### No Results Returned\\n\\n**Quick Checks:**\\n\\n```javascript theme={null}\\n// 1. Verify documents exist\\nconst docs = await alchemyst.v1.context.view();\\nconsole.log(`Total docs: ${docs.length}`);\\n\\n// 2. Try broader search\\nconst result = await alchemyst.v1.context.search({\\n  query: \\\"your query\\\",\\n  similarity_threshold: 0.5, // Lower threshold\\n  groupName: [\\\"broad_tag\\\"] // Fewer filters\\n});\\n```\\n\\n**Common Causes:**\\n\\n* High minimum\\\\_similarity\\\\_threshold set\\n* groupnames don't intersect\\n* Query is not relevant or very specific\\n\\n**Solutions :**\\n\\n1. Verify documents exist : [platform](https://platform.getalchemystai.com/context)\\n2. Reduce similarity\\\\_threshold from 0.6-0.7 to 0.5-0.6\\n3. Remove overly specific groupNames\\n4. Try with a general query, make sure it's not too specific\\n\\n***\\n\\n### Common Scenarios\\n\\n#### Scenario: Queries Return Too Many Fragments\\n\\n* **Problem:** Search returns 50+ small chunks\\n* **Cause:** Over-segmentation (see [Anti-Pattern 1](/advanced/usage-patterns#anti-pattern-1%3A-over-segmentation))\\n* **Solution:** Combine related content into cohesive documents\\n\\n#### Scenario : Metadata Bloat Symptoms\\n\\n* **Problem:** Storing too much or redundant information in metadata\\n* **Cause:** Metadata bloating (see [Anti-Pattern 2](/advanced/usage-patterns#anti-pattern-2%3A-metadata-bloat))\\n* **Solution:** Limit metadata to only what you query/filter by, pass all the other things in the content itself.\\n\\n## Debugging Tools\\n\\n* Context traces [API](/api-reference/endpoint/api/v1/context/traces/get) or [Platform](https://platform.getalchemystai.com/traces)\\n* Verbose SDK [logging](/integrations/sdk/python-sdk#logging)\\n* Health check endpoints\\n\\n### Platform Limits\\n\\n| Feature                  | Limit / Specification                                         |\\n| :----------------------- | :------------------------------------------------------------ |\\n| **Max File Size**        | 50 MB per document                                            |\\n| **Max Batch Size**       | 100 documents per `add()` request                             |\\n| **Supported File Types** | `.pdf`, `.txt`, `.docx`, `.md`, `.json`, `.csv`               |\\n| **Token Limit**          | 8,192 tokens per document chunk                               |\\n| **Metadata Fields**      | Max 20 keys per document; Values must be `string` or `number` |\\n| **Indexing Speed**       | \\\\~120 records/sec (Text), \\\\~5 sec/page (OCR PDF)              |\\n\\n## Still Stuck?\\n\\n* Check our [Discord](https://docs.getalchemystai.com/join-discord?utm_source=docs\\\\&utm_medium=referral\\\\&utm_campaign=discord_join) for community help\\n\"}]"},{"role":"tool","tool_call_id":"call_hu9t4dVy3BWlkzgD84uU3tkJ","content":"[{\"type\":\"text\",\"text\":\"Title: \\n\\nURL Source: https://getalchemystai.com/docs/llms.txt\\n\\nMarkdown Content:\\n# Alchemyst AI Documentation\\n\\n## Docs\\n\\n- [Context Arithmetic](https://getalchemystai.com/docs/advanced/context-arithmetic.md): Understanding the foundational principles on which Alchemyst works\\n- [Overview](https://getalchemystai.com/docs/advanced/overview.md): Unlock the full potential of the Alchemyst Platform\\n- [Architecting Context-aware systems](https://getalchemystai.com/docs/advanced/realworld-use-cases.md): Use cases that leverage context arithmetic for building robust context aware AI systems.\\n- [Errors & Platform Limits](https://getalchemystai.com/docs/advanced/troubleshooting.md): Understanding common issues you might face, while building with Alchemyst\\n- [Usage Patterns Primer](https://getalchemystai.com/docs/advanced/usage-patterns.md): Advanced usage patterns to let you take full advantage of context arithmetic\\n- [User Profiling for AI Applications](https://getalchemystai.com/docs/advanced/user-profiling.md): Build AI systems that understand and adapt to individual users through intelligent memory and profiling.\\n- [Asynchronously queue context data to add to the context processor](https://getalchemystai.com/docs/api-reference/endpoint/api/v1/context/add-async/post.md): This endpoint accepts context data and queues it for asynchronous processing by the context processor. Types are available out-of-the-box in TypeScript.\\n\\n#### Context: Add\\n\\n```ts theme={null}\\nimport AlchemystAI from '@alchemystai/sdk';\\n\\nconst client = new AlchemystAI({\\n    apiKey: process.env.ALCHEMYST_AI_API_KEY,\\n});\\n\\ntry {\\n    await client.v1.context.add({\\n       // [REQUIRED] The actual data to embed\\n      documents: [\\n                {\\n                  content: 'The content of the document',\\n                },\\n              ],\\n              // [REQUIRED] System classifications\\n              context_type: 'resource',\\n              source: 'web-upload',\\n              scope: 'internal',\\n\\n              // [OPTIONAL] Can be null. If you use `groupName` in previous versions, you will encounter an error. If `groupName` is not provided, it will be set to a default value REDACTEDmatically. \\n\\n **groupName**: The group name acts like a namespace which creates a scope for context. Documents with the same group name will be grouped together for better organization and retrieval. **Example Use Cases**: * `['project-alpha']` - Group all documents related to a specific project * `['customer-support', 'tier-1']` - Organize support documentation by department and priority * `['legal', 'contracts']` - Categorize legal documents by type and category * `['training', 'onboarding']` - Group training materials for new employee onboarding \\n\\n#### Context: Search\\n\\n```ts theme={null}\\nimport AlchemystAI from '@alchemystai/sdk';\\n\\nconst client = new AlchemystAI({\\n  apiKey: process.env.ALCHEMYST_AI_API_KEY,\\n});\\n\\ntry {\\n  const { contexts } = await client.v1.context.search({\\n\\n    // [REQUIRED] Core search parameters\\n    query: 'Your search query here',\\n    similarity_threshold: 0.8,\\n    minimum_similarity_threshold: 0.5,\\n    scope: 'internal',\\n\\n    // Optional - can be null\\n    body_metadata: {\\n       groupName: ['project-alpha'],\\n       fileType: 'ai/conversation',\\n    },\\n  });\\n\\n  console.log(contexts);\\n\\n} \\ncatch (error) {\\n  console.error(\\\"Search failed:\\\", error);\\n}\\n```\\n\\n#### Click to view chunks and metadata\\n\\n***\\n\\n## Step 4: Search for Context\\n\\n ```typescript TypeScript theme={null} const userQuestion = \\\"What's your refund policy?\\\"; const { contexts } = await client.v1.context.search({ query: userQuestion, similarity_threshold: 0.7, scope: 'internal' }); console.log(`Found ${contexts?.length || 0} relevant chunks`); // Output: Found 1 relevant chunks console.log(contexts[0].content); // Output: \\\"Our refund policy: We offer a 30-day money back guarantee...\\\" ``` ```python Python theme={null} user_question = \\\"What's your refund policy?\\\" result = client.v1.context.search( query=user_question, similarity_threshold=0.7, scope=\\\"internal\\\" ) contexts = result.contexts or [] print(f\\\"Found {len(contexts)} relevant chunks\\\") # Output: Found 1 relevant chunks print(contexts[0].content) # Output: \\\"Our refund policy: We offer a 30-day money back guarantee...\\\" ``` \\n\\n### Understanding similarity\\\\_threshold\\n\\n| Value | Meaning           | When to Use                        |\\n| ----- | ----------------- | ---------------------------------- |\\n| `0.5` | Somewhat relevant | Exploratory searches, broad topics |\\n| `0.7` | Relevant          | **Start here** - good balance      |\\n| `0.9` | Very relevant     | Precise matches, technical queries |\\n\\n **Tip:** Start at 0.7, lower to 0.5 if you get no results, raise to 0.9 if results are too broad. \\n\\n***\\n\\n## Step 5: Feed Context to Your LLM\\n\\n ```typescript TypeScript theme={null} import OpenAI from 'openai'; const openai = new OpenAI(); const prompt = contexts?.length ? `Context:\\\\n${contexts.map(c => c.content).join('\\\\n\\\\n')}\\\\n\\\\nQuestion: ${userQuestion}` : userQuestion; const response = await openai.chat.completions.create({ model: \\\"gpt-4\\\", messages: [{ role: \\\"user\\\", content: prompt }] }); console.log(response.choices[0].message.content); // Output: \\\"We offer a 30-day money back guarantee. To request a refund, contact support@example.com.\\\" ``` ```python Python theme={null} import openai if contexts: context_text = \\\"\\\\n\\\\n\\\".join([ctx.content for ctx in contexts]) prompt = f\\\"Context:\\\\n{context_text}\\\\n\\\\nQuestion: {user_question}\\\" else: prompt = user_question response = openai.chat.completions.create( model=\\\"gpt-4\\\", messages=[{\\\"role\\\": \\\"user\\\", \\\"content\\\": prompt}] ) print(response.choices[0].message.content) # Output: \\\"We offer a 30-day money back guarantee. To request a refund, contact support@example.com.\\\" ``` \\n\\n**Result:** Your AI now answers from YOUR data, not generic training data.\\n\\n***\\n\\n## Complete Working Example\\n\\n  ```typescript theme={null} import AlchemystAI from '@alchemystai/sdk'; import OpenAI from 'openai'; const alchemyst = new AlchemystAI({ apiKey: process.env.ALCHEMYST_AI_API_KEY, }); const openai = new OpenAI(); async function main() { // 1. console.log(`Found ${contexts?.length} results in customer-support`); ``` ```python Python theme={null} # Store with groups client.v1.context.add( documents=[{ \\\"content\\\": \\\"Refund policy: We offer a 30-day money back guarantee...\\\", \\\"metadata\\\": { \\\"file_name\\\": \\\"refund-policy.md\\\", \\\"group_name\\\": [\\\"customer-support\\\", \\\"policies\\\"] # ← For storage } }], context_type=\\\"resource\\\", source=\\\"documentation\\\", scope=\\\"internal\\\" ) # Search within specific groups result = client.v1.context.search( query=\\\"refund policy\\\", scope=\\\"internal\\\", metadata={ \\\"group_name\\\": [\\\"customer-support\\\"] # ← For search (note: snake_case) } ) print(f\\\"Found {len(result.contexts or [])} results in customer-support\\\") ``` \\n\\n **Naming difference:** Storage uses `group_name` (snake\\\\_case in metadata) but TypeScript search uses `groupName` (camelCase). Python uses `group_name` consistently. Both refer to the same field - this is due to API design conventions. \\n\\n### Why use groups?\\n\\n| Benefit                 | Description                                             |\\n| ----------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------- |\\n| **Faster searches**     | Smaller search space = lower latency                    |\\n| **More relevant**       | Only search customer-support docs, not engineering docs |\\n| **Better organization** | Hierarchical structure like folders                     |\\n| **Access control**      | Filter by team, project, or user permissions            |\\n\\n**Example hierarchy:**\\n\\n```typescript theme={null}\\ngroup_name: [\\\"company\\\", \\\"customer-support\\\", \\\"policies\\\"]\\ngroup_name: [\\\"company\\\", \\\"engineering\\\", \\\"api-docs\\\"]\\ngroup_name: [\\\"company\\\", \\\"hr\\\", \\\"employee-handbook\\\"]\\n```\\n\\nLearn more: [Context Arithmetic](/advanced/context-arithmetic)\\n\\n***\\n\\n## Troubleshooting\\n\\n  **Error symptoms:** * `contexts?.length` returns 0 * Empty array in search results **Common causes:** 1. `similarity_threshold` is too high 2. Document wasn't stored successfully 3. `scope` mismatch between add and search **Fixes:** **Step 1: Lower the threshold:** ```typescript theme={null} similarity_threshold: 0.5 // Instead of 0.9 ``` **Step 2: Verify documents were stored:** ```typescript theme={null} const stored = await client.v1.context.view(); console.log(\\\"Total documents:\\\", stored.length); console.log(\\\"Documents:\\\", stored); ``` **Expected output:** ``` Total documents: 1 Documents: [{ id: \\\"doc_123\\\", content: \\\"Our refund policy...\\\", ... }] ``` **Step 3: Check scope matches:** ```typescript theme={null} // Both must use the same scope await client.v1.context.add({ scope: 'internal', ... }); await client.v1.context.search({ scope: 'internal', ... }); // ✅ Match ```   **Error symptoms:** * Getting documents that don't match the query * Too many results to process efficiently **Common causes:** 1. `similarity_threshold` is too low 2. Documents are too broad or generic 3. Not using group filtering **Fixes:** **Step 1: Raise the threshold:** ```typescript theme={null} similarity_threshold: 0.8 // More strict (was 0.5) ``` **Step 2: Use group filtering:** ```typescript theme={null} metadata: { groupName: ['customer-support'] // Narrow to specific category } ``` **Step 3: Add more specific metadata:** ```typescript theme={null} await client.v1.context.add({ documents: [{ content: \\\"...\\\", metadata: { group_name: [\\\"support\\\", \\\"refunds\\\"], // More specific category: \\\"policies\\\", department: \\\"customer-service\\\" } }] }); ```   **Error message:** ```json theme={null} { \\\"error\\\": \\\"Document with file_name 'policy.md' already exists\\\", \\\"code\\\": \\\"CONFLICT\\\", \\\"status\\\": 409 } ``` **Cause:** Trying to add a document with duplicate `file_name` in metadata. **Fixes:** **Step 1: Delete old version first:** ```typescript theme={null} // Delete by file name await client.v1.context.delete({ metadata: { fileName: \\\"policy.md\\\" } }); // Then add new version await client.v1.context.add({ documents: [{ content: \\\"Updated content...\\\", metadata: { file_name: \\\"policy.md\\\" } }] }); ``` **Step 2: Use versioned names:** ```typescript theme={null} file_name: \\\"policy-v2.md\\\" // or \\\"policy-2024-02-01.md\\\" ``` **Step 3: Use unique identifiers:** ```typescript theme={null} file_name: `policy-${Date.now()}.md` // Timestamp // or file_name: `policy-${uuid()}.md` // UUID ```   **Error message:** ```json theme={null} { \\\"error\\\": \\\"Invalid API key\\\", \\\"code\\\": \\\"UNAUTHORIZED\\\", \\\"status\\\": 401 } ``` **Fixes:** **Step 1: Verify API key is set:** ```typescript theme={null} console.log(\\\"API Key exists:\\\", !!process.env.ALCHEMYST_AI_API_KEY); // Should output: API Key exists: true ``` **Step 2: Check key format:** ```typescript theme={null} // Should start with \\\"alch_\\\" or similar prefix console.log(\\\"Key prefix:\\\", process.env.ALCHEMYST_AI_API_KEY?.substring(0, 5)); ``` **Step 3: Get a new key:** * Visit [platform.getalchemystai.com/settings](https://platform.getalchemystai.com/settings?utm_source=docs\\\\&utm_campaign=contextual_ai_quickstart\\\\&utm_medium=quickstart_article\\\\&utm_content=troubleshooting_api_key_settings) * Generate a new API key * Update your `.env` file   **Error message:** ```json theme={null} { \\\"error\\\": \\\"Rate limit exceeded\\\", \\\"code\\\": \\\"RATE_LIMIT\\\", \\\"status\\\": 429, \\\"retry_after\\\": 60 } ``` **Cause:** Too many requests in a short time period. **Fixes:** **Step 1: Add retry logic:** ```typescript theme={null} async function searchWithRetry(query: string, retries = 3) { for (let i = 0; i < retries; i++) { try { return await client.v1.context.search({ query, scope: 'internal' }); } catch (error) { if (error.status === 429 && i < retries - 1) { const waitTime = error.retry_after || 60; console.log(`Rate limited. Waiting ${waitTime}s...`); await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, waitTime * 1000)); } else { throw error; } } } } ``` **Step 2: Check your rate limits:** * Free tier: 100 operations/day * Pro tier: 10,000 operations/day **Step 3: Upgrade your plan:** [View pricing](https://platform.getalchemystai.com/settings/billing?utm_source=docs\\\\&utm_campaign=contextual_ai_quickstart\\\\&utm_medium=quickstart_article\\\\&utm_content=troubleshooting_rate_limit_billing) \\n\\n***\\n\\n## Best Practices\\n\\n### Document Organization\\n\\n```typescript theme={null}\\n// ✅ Good - organized with meaningful metadata\\nawait client.v1.context.add({\\n  documents: [{\\n    content: \\\"...\\\",\\n    metadata: {\\n      file_name: \\\"refund-policy-2024-02.md\\\",\\n      group_name: [\\\"customer-support\\\", \\\"policies\\\"],\\n      department: \\\"support\\\",\\n      last_updated: \\\"2024-02-01\\\"\\n    }\\n  }]\\n});\\n\\n// ❌ Bad - minimal metadata, hard to search\\nawait client.v1.context.add({\\n  documents: [{\\n    content: \\\"...\\\"\\n  }]\\n});\\n```\\n\\n### Chunk Size Considerations\\n\\n* **Small documents** (under 1000 words): Add as-is\\n* **Medium documents** (1000-5000 words): Let Alchemyst REDACTED-chunk\\n* **Large documents** (over 5000 words): Consider splitting by section\\n\\n```typescript theme={null}\\n// For large documents, split manually for better control\\nconst sections = [\\n  { title: \\\"Introduction\\\", content: \\\"...\\\" },\\n  { title: \\\"Features\\\", content: \\\"...\\\" },\\n  { title: \\\"Pricing\\\", content: \\\"...\\\" }\\n];\\n\\nconst docs = sections.map(section => ({\\n  content: section.content,\\n  metadata: {\\n    file_name: \\\"product-docs.md\\\",\\n    section: section.title\\n  }\\n}));\\n\\nawait client.v1.context.add({ documents: docs });\\n```\\n\\n### Search Optimization\\n\\n```typescript theme={null}\\n// ✅ Good - specific query with filtering\\nconst { contexts } = await client.v1.context.search({\\n  query: \\\"How to request a refund for damaged items\\\",\\n  scope: 'internal',\\n  similarity_threshold: 0.7,\\n  metadata: {\\n    groupName: ['customer-support', 'refunds']\\n  }\\n});\\n\\n// ❌ Bad - too broad, no filtering\\nconst { contexts } = await client.v1.context.search({\\n  query: \\\"help\\\",\\n  scope: 'internal'\\n});\\n```\\n\\n### Error Handling\\n\\n```typescript theme={null}\\nasync function safeSearch(query: string) {\\n  try {\\n    const { contexts } = await client.v1.context.search({\\n      query,\\n      scope: 'internal',\\n      similarity_threshold: 0.7\\n    });\\n    \\n    if (!contexts || contexts.length === 0) {\\n      console.log(\\\"No results found. Try a broader query.\\\");\\n      return null;\\n    }\\n    \\n    return contexts;\\n  } catch (error) {\\n    console.error(\\\"Search failed:\\\", error.message);\\n    // Fallback or retry logic here\\n    return null;\\n  }\\n}\\n```\\n\\n***\\n\\n## Verify Your Setup\\n\\nAfter implementing context search, verify everything is working:\\n\\n### Check Platform UI\\n\\n1. [see Upload Errors](#common-errors-add)\\n* Search not working? [go to Search Errors](#common-errors-search)\\n* Slow performance? [look at Performance Issues](#performance-issues)\\n* Wrong results? [Check Retrieval Quality](#retrieval-quality-issues)\\n\\n## API Errors\\n\\n### Common errors (Add)\\n\\n| Status Code | Error Type        | Common Cause                                                                      | Recommended Fix                                                                                                                                       |\\n| :---------- | :---------------- | :-------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | :---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |\\n| **400**     | `BadRequest`      | Invalid JSON or missing required fields (e.g., `source`).                         | Validate your payload against the [schema](/api-reference/endpoint/api/v1/context/add/post). Ensure `documents` array is not empty.                   |\\n| **401**     | `Unauthorized`    | Invalid or missing `ALCHEMYST_AI_API_KEY`.                                        | Check your `.env` file. Ensure you aren't using a Test key in Prod.                                                                                   |\\n| **403**     | `Forbidden`       | Accessing a `scope` (e.g., `user_123`) you don't have permission for.             | Verify the `api_key` or `user_id` matches the authenticated session. Make sure the key is still valid.                                                |\\n| **409**     | `Conflict`        | Document with the same `fileName` already exists.                                 | Follow [Pattern 2: Document Updates](/advanced/usage-patterns#pattern-2%3A-handling-document-updates) to update or replace existing documents safely. |\\n| **413**     | `PayloadTooLarge` | Document exceeds the 50MB limit or batch size > 100.                              | Split your `documents` array into chunks of 50 and retry.                                                                                             |\\n| **429**     | `RateLimit`       | Exceeded 1000 requests/minute.                                                    | Implement exponential backoff (default in SDK). Contact support for higher limits.                                                                    |\\n| **422**     | `Unprocessable`   | The file type provided in `metadata` matches `source` but content is unparseable. | Ensure `fileType` matches the actual binary content (e.g., don’t send PDF bytes as `text/plain`).                                                     |\\n\\n### Common errors (Search)\\n\\n| Status Code | Error Type      | Common Cause                                  | Recommended Fix                                                                                                                             |\\n| :---------- | :-------------- | :-------------------------------------------- | :------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |\\n| **400**     | `BadRequest`    | Missing or malformed search parameters.       | Ensure `query` is provided and properly formatted.Validate your payload against the [schema](/api-reference/endpoint/api/v1/context/search) |\\n| **401**     | `Unauthorized`  | Invalid or missing `ALCHEMYST_AI_API_KEY`.    | Confirm the request includes a valid API key.                                                                                               |\\n| **403**     | `Forbidden`     | Searching a `scope` you don't have access to. | Make sure the key is still valid. Ensure the search `scope` is accessible to the current user or org.                                       |\\n| **429**     | `RateLimit`     | Too many search requests.                     | Add throttling or cache repeated searches.                                                                                                  |\\n| **422**     | `Unprocessable` | Documents were not indexed correctly.         | Verify documents were successfully ingested before searching.                                                                               |\\n\\n## Application-Level Issues\\n\\n### Performance issues\\n\\n#### Slow Ingestion\\n\\n**Diagnosis:**\\n\\n```javascript theme={null}\\n// Sequential adds: ~30 seconds for 1000 docs\\nfor (let i = 0; i < 1000; i++) {\\n  await alchemyst.add(documents[i]);\\n}\\n\\n// Async add: ~3 seconds for 1000 docs (10x faster!)\\n// documents is an array of content\\nconst documents = [];\\ndocuments.push({\\n  content: \\\"files content\\\",\\n  metadata: { // optional\\n    file_name: \\\"file_name\\\",\\n    file_type: \\\"pdf/txt/json\\\",\\n    group_name: [\\\"group1\\\", \\\"group2\\\"],\\n  },\\n});\\n\\nawait alchemyst.add(documents);\\n```\\n\\n**Common Causes:**\\n\\n* Document size > 50MB (max file size - 50MB)\\n* Large number of documents uploaded sequentially\\n* Token limit reached\\n\\n**Solutions :**\\n\\n1. Make sure the doc size is less then 50MB\\n2. Upload documents via bulkAdd (faster)\\n3. Check if you have sufficent tokens\\n4. For bulk operations read [here](/advanced/usage-patterns#pattern-4%3A-bulk-operations-at-scale)\\n\\n***\\n\\n#### Slow Searches (> 1 second)\\n\\n**Quick Checks:**\\n\\n```javascript theme={null}\\n// Measure your query time\\nconst start = Date.now();\\nconst result = await alchemyst.v1.context.search({\\n  groupName: [\\\"a\\\", \\\"b\\\", \\\"c\\\", \\\"d\\\", \\\"e\\\", \\\"f\\\", \\\"g\\\"] // 7 filters!\\n});\\nconsole.log(`Search took ${Date.now() - start}ms`);\\n```\\n\\n**Common Causes:**\\n\\n* 7+ groupName tags (exponential overhead)\\n* No minimum\\\\_similarity\\\\_threshold set\\n* 10K+ documents in scope\\n\\n**Solutions:**\\n\\n1. Reduce to 3-5 groupName tags max\\n2. Set minimum\\\\_similarity\\\\_threshold: 0.5\\n3. Use namespaces to shard data\\n\\n***\\n\\n### Retrieval Quality Issues\\n\\n#### No Results Returned\\n\\n**Quick Checks:**\\n\\n```javascript theme={null}\\n// 1. Verify documents exist\\nconst docs = await alchemyst.v1.context.view();\\nconsole.log(`Total docs: ${docs.length}`);\\n\\n// 2. Try broader search\\nconst result = await alchemyst.v1.context.search({\\n  query: \\\"your query\\\",\\n  similarity_threshold: 0.5, // Lower threshold\\n  groupName: [\\\"broad_tag\\\"] // Fewer filters\\n});\\n```\\n\\n**Common Causes:**\\n\\n* High minimum\\\\_similarity\\\\_threshold set\\n* groupnames don't intersect\\n* Query is not relevant or very specific\\n\\n**Solutions :**\\n\\n1. Verify documents exist : [platform](https://platform.getalchemystai.com/context)\\n2. Reduce similarity\\\\_threshold from 0.6-0.7 to 0.5-0.6\\n3. Remove overly specific groupNames\\n4. IMPORTANT: Never use the -uall flag as it can cause memory issues on large repos.\n  - Run a git diff command to see both staged and unstaged changes that will be committed.\n  - Run a git log command to see recent commit messages, so that you can follow this repository's commit message style.\n2.
